title: Area 51 caller: extradimensional beings contacted by early space program

tellings.quote: Okay. Um um Okay. what what we're thinking of as as aliens are. They're uh they're they're extradimensional beings that [laughter] an earlier precursor of the um space program made contact with.

plain: In 1997 a caller to Coast to Coast AM, a late-night American radio show then hosted by Art Bell, said that what we think of as aliens are really "extradimensional beings," beings from another dimension, that "an earlier precursor of the space program made contact with." The caller presented himself as someone with first-hand knowledge of Area 51, a secret US military test site in Nevada, and the recording comes up in an episode with the hip hop artist Flying Lotus. If true, it would mean contact was made long ago and kept secret.
